title: Creator of All
story:
A young artist once spent months creating a beautiful sculpture.

People came to admire it.

They praised its beauty.

One visitor asked,

“Does the sculpture give you anything in return?”

The artist smiled and said,

“No, it is not the sculpture that sustains me.”

“I created it. It depends on me.”

The visitor paused and thought deeply.

In life, we often think we are self-sufficient.

We believe we control everything.

But everything we have comes from somewhere.

Life.

Breath.

Strength.

Time.

All are gifts.

God is not dependent on anything we give.

Instead, we are fully dependent on Him.

He gives life to all.

And everything exists because of Him.
life_lesson:
God is the Creator and Sustainer of all life.

We depend on Him for everything.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

You are the Creator of all things.

Everything I have comes from You.

Help me to live in humility and gratitude.

Remind me that my life depends on You every moment.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you sometimes feel fully self-sufficient in life?

How does knowing God is your Creator change your perspective?

What are you thankful to God for today?
verse:
The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth.
He is not served by human hands, as if He needed anything.
Rather, He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.
